'''Steven Michael Goodman''' (born August 3, 1957)<ref>{{cite web|title=Steven M. Goodman CV|url= https://www.fieldmuseum.org/sites/default/files/cv/SMGCV.August.2012.DOC|publisher=The Field Museum}}</ref> is an American [[conservation biologist]], and field biologist on staff in the Department of Zoology at the [[Field Museum of Natural History]] in Chicago.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.fieldmuseum.org/about/staff/profile/steven-goodman |title=Steve Goodman|work=The Field Museum|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230505124422/https://www.fieldmuseum.org/about/staff/profile/steven-goodman |archive-date=2023-05-05 }}</ref>

==Life==
He graduated from the Interlochen Arts Academy High School in 1975. He graduated from the [[University of Michigan]] with a B.S. in 1984,<ref name="field">{{cite web |url=http://www.fieldmuseum.org/MUSEUM_INFO/press/press_goodman2.htm |title=The Field Museum Information: Press Room |website=www.fieldmuseum.org |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090317190634/http://www.fieldmuseum.org/museum_info/press/press_goodman2.htm |archive-date=2009-03-17}} </ref> from the [[University of Hamburg]] with a Ph.D. in 2000,<ref name="field"/> and from the [[Paris-Sud 11 University|Université Paris-Sud XI]], with an H.D.R. in 2005.<ref name="field"/> In the early 1990s, with the [[World Wildlife Fund]], he created the Ecological Training Program (ETP).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.worldwildlife.org/what/wherewework/madagascar/peoplestevegoodman.html|title=Madagascar|work=World Wildlife Fund}}</ref>

==Awards==
*2005 [[MacArthur Fellows Program]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Steven Goodman – MacArthur Foundation|url=https://www.macfound.org/fellows/760/ }}</ref> 
*Biodiversity Award<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.biodiversityleadershipawards.org/goodman.htm|title=Bay Biodiversity Awards -- Steven M. Goodman|work=biodiversityleadershipawards.org}}</ref>

==Works==
*''Extinct Madagascar: Picturing the Island's Past''. Steven M. Goodman, William L. Jungers, University of Chicago Press, 2014, {{ISBN|978-0-226-14397-2}}
*''The Natural History of Madagascar''. Editors	Steven M. Goodman, Jonathan P. Benstead, University of Chicago Press, 2003, {{ISBN|978-0-226-30306-2}}
*''The Birds of Egypt''. Edited by Steven M. Goodman & Peter L. Meininger, Oxford University Press, 1989, {{ISBN|0-19-857644-7}}
